page.title: Workbench
page.empty_title: Tell the team what needs doing
page.empty_description: Describe the work in your own words. Multica routes it to the right department, and its lead breaks it into tasks.
page.composer_hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
page.binding_required_description: Your agent represents you when you send work to a department. Bind one to start dispatching; browsing and reviewing stay available.
page.empty_history: Work you send will appear here.

examples.one: Prepare next week's customer onboarding materials
examples.three: Write a launch announcement for the new dashboard

page.thread_hint: Enter to send to the department

status.queued: Sent to the department. Its lead will pick it up shortly.
status.decomposing: The department lead is breaking this into tasks…
status.failed: The department lead couldn't start this. The department owner has been notified.
status.queued_personal: Sent to your squad. Its lead will pick it up shortly.
status.decomposing_personal: Your squad lead is breaking this into tasks…
status.failed_personal: Your squad lead couldn't start this.

card.failure_hint: You can retry, or follow up on the issue.

result.title: Result
result.empty: No result was posted on the issue. Open the issue to see what was delivered.

reassign.title: Reassign department
reassign.description: The issue moves to another department's squad and wakes its lead again.
reassign.empty: No other department can take this right now.

errors.ambiguous: Several departments could take this. Pick one below.
errors.dispatch_text_too_long: That's too long. Keep it under 4,000 characters.
errors.org_dispatch_unit_not_found: That department no longer exists. Choose another or let Multica route it.
errors.org_dispatch_forbidden: You don't have access to that department.
errors.agent_binding_required: Bind an agent before sending work to a department.
errors.org_dispatch_no_agents: That department has no agents yet. Add one on the organization page.
errors.org_dispatch_leader_unavailable: The department lead can't be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.org_dispatch_leader_offline: No agent in that department is online. Ask its lead to start a runtime, then send this again.
errors.org_dispatch_unroutable: Couldn't tell which department should take this. Name a department or add more detail.
errors.org_dispatch_failed: The work couldn't be sent to the department.
errors.followup_failed: Couldn't add to this work. Try again.
errors.upload_failed: A file didn't upload. Try again.
errors.personal_squad_not_found: That personal squad no longer exists. Send again to start a new one.
errors.org_dispatch_target_conflict: Choose either a department or your squad.
errors.org_dispatch_reassign_forbidden: Only the requester can reassign this work.
errors.dispatch_not_found: This work is no longer in your dispatch history.
errors.dispatch_organization_only: Work is sent from the organization's workbench.

review.reason_placeholder: Tell the department what to fix
review.accept_failed: Couldn't accept the result. Try again.
review.reject_failed: Couldn't send it back. Try again.
